title: corybas minimus
intro: Corybas minimus, commonly known as the dwarf greenhood orchid, is a species of orchid native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Corybas minimus are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions like bronchitis and pneumonia. The bioactive constituents of Corybas minimus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
